summary: thiscall that removes every element in an object array. Reads the element count at this+0xBA8 (this[746]); when it is greater than zero, walks the array starting at this+747 (float) with stride 187 floats and calls sub_4DF110(element, a2, -1) for each element. The count at this+0xBA8 is re-read every iteration and drives the loop condition; the final count is returned. Structural twin of UIElementMultiDispatch (004e39d0) per cluster prelabel.

operations.description: Read the element count from this+0xBA8 (this[746]) into result.
Only enter the removal loop when the count at this+0xBA8 is greater than zero; otherwise return the count immediately.
do-while loop over the count using counter v4, starting at the first element pointer this+747 (float).
Call sub_4DF110(element, a2, -1) for each element to remove it.
Advance the element pointer v5 by 187 floats (748 bytes) between iterations to reach the next element.
Re-read the count at this+0xBA8 each iteration and re-compare it with the counter v4 to drive the loop condition.
Return the last read count value.
Invoked from loading/teardown paths (LoadingPhase1, LoadingPhase2, sub_4B9B80) to remove a set of objects during phase transitions.

unresolved: Identity of the removed element type and the meaning of the sub_4DF110 arguments (a2, -1) are unknown.
The owner object holding the array at this+0xBA8 is unknown; the prelabel names it a structural twin of UIElementMultiDispatch (004e39d0).
